source_review.notes: Reviewed Rodeh's primary shadowing/clone B-tree paper, Coburn et al.'s primary persistent-memory discussion, current Btrfs design/B-tree/introduction and Linux kernel documentation, and current OpenZFS CoW/pool documentation. All eight final destinations returned HTTP 200. Product-specific root, logging, checksum, and reference behavior remains scoped to those implementations.

evidence: Checked root/version, reachability, live-root union, height, page size, copied-page count, logical/physical write, generation, retirement, and reuse notation.
Checked object identity, value equality, location identity, generation identity, and checksum expectation are distinguished.
Checked write-amplification ratios require an explicit numerator/denominator and inclusion policy.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Abstract immutable persistence is consistently separated from durable shadow paging and product transaction semantics.

evidence: Recomputed insertion 13 copies/new-creates nodes 13,14,12,8 and shares nodes 2,4,6,10.
Recomputed seven old plus eight new minus four shared equals eleven distinct nodes; dropping old root leaves three old-only nodes 8,12,14.
Recomputed 4 KiB logical update with four 16 KiB metadata pages as at least 64 KiB and ratio 16 before other writes.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The amplification example is a lower-bound illustration under stated page sizes, not a measured product result.

evidence: Verified recursive path copying preserves every node reachable from old root and changes only the new root's search path.
Verified structural induction yields exact old map and updated new map when local ordering/balance transformations hold.
Verified reclaimability requires absence from the union of all live roots plus clearance of in-flight generation-bearing references.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Split/merge and concurrent writer refinements retain their separate variant-specific proof obligations.

evidence: Reviewed empty/single root, unchanged-key update, root split, cascading split/merge, batch conflicts, long snapshots/readers, clone divergence, and nested root lifetimes.
Reviewed torn/stale root slots, corrupt/missing children, checksum mismatch, generation wrap/reuse, reference underflow/overflow, cycles, duplicate ownership, and orphan private graphs.
Reviewed ENOSPC, fragmentation, cleaner workspace, late I/O, flush reorder, failed fsync intent, writer races, replica/backup lag, deletion progress, and crash during recursive free.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: The finite model excludes balancing, pages, persistence, concurrency, checksums, allocation, and failures.

evidence: Frozen nodes prevent mutation; insertion constructs new ancestors and reuses unchanged child objects.
Recursive validation checks strict BST ancestor bounds for both roots; in-order outputs check exact old/new abstract contents.
Identity-set arithmetic checks copied/new, shared, union, and old-only reachability counts plus membership behavior for key 13.
invariant_checking.notes: Python identity evidence is scoped to one execution and is not a page-generation or memory-reclamation proof.

evidence: Reviewed abstract version induction across immutable descent, new child return, parent reconstruction, off-path sharing, and old/new map semantics.

Reviewed durable publication from reservation through child-before-parent writes, checksum/identity references, barriers, redundant root selection, candidate validation/fallback, and orphan reconciliation.
Reviewed reclamation from complete live-root enumeration through count/trace accounting, retirement, epoch/generation barriers, crash reconciliation, and later reuse.
proof_review.notes: The storage protocol is a set of explicit obligations, not a mechanized proof or verified filesystem/database implementation.

evidence: Abstract version, durable publication, and reclamation proof structures are separately labeled.
CoW is not claimed to remove intent logging, synchronous durability, allocator recovery, atomic-write, or transaction needs.
Product documentation, finite object model, checksum checks, crash-test prescriptions, and performance measurements are not generalized into universal proof.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Snapshot creation cost, retained space, logical immutability, and durable consistency are explicitly distinct claims.

evidence: The standard-library Python model passed exact thirteen-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under the repository verifier.
It reproduced exact old/new order, root keys, four copied/new nodes, four shared nodes, lookup separation, eleven-node union, three old-only nodes, and valid=True.
All eight external destinations returned HTTP 200 and repository-local structure/link checks passed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No durable page, allocator/reference tree, root slot, file/device I/O, concurrent writer/reader, snapshot product, fsync, crash recovery, scrub, fuzzing, or performance experiment was run.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter derives structural sharing from immutability, then adds the missing durable responsibilities: parent-authenticated blocks, child-before-parent ordering, root selection, complete live-root ownership, delayed reuse, synchronous promises, and space reserves.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed page/version formats, root rings, flush/fallback, snapshot/clone/reference lifecycle, multiwriter conflict, intent logging, ENOSPC/fragmentation, scrub/repair, backup/replica retention, migration/rollback, and full amplification/space telemetry.

pedagogical_review.notes: The compact immutable model makes path copy and sharing countable; the one-page review states the full live-root invariant; ten examples span abstract, crash, concurrency, corruption, space, and measurement cases; five exercises supply complete durable designs and audits.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/maintainer-source, mathematical, bounded executable-model, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, Rodeh, Coburn, IBM, Btrfs, Linux, OpenZFS, filesystem, database, persistent-memory, concurrency, reliability, security, performance, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and model prove neither balancing/splits, durable pages, allocator/reference accounting, root atomicity, fsync semantics, snapshot/clone implementation, concurrent writers/readers, crash recovery, corruption repair, production amplification, certification, nor deployment fitness.
